items.html: And so we find that these lights from the chest downward come covered, and you already know that the concealment and covering of the light constitutes its correction, for through this the vessel has the strength to bear the light when it comes clothed. Accordingly, the breaking of the vessels from the chest downward — which are the two lower thirds of Tifferet, and Netzah-Hod-Yesod, and Malchut — was not equal to the breaking of the vessels of Daat, Hesed-Gevura, and the upper third of Tifferet, for certainly the breaking of the upper ones was greater than the breaking of the lower ones. Therefore, when the correction of Zeir Anpin comes, at the time of the correction of his Partzuf, it comes in reverse: for from the two lower thirds of Tifferet downward, his lights and the Hassadim within them were revealed, and this is because they had the ability to receive them without the screen of Bina, since their breaking was not great. But the upper ones, which are from the head of Zeir Anpin to the chest, came in the correction sealed and clothed now within the screen of Bina, which is her Yesod, as is known. And this is because at first they were revealed and their breaking was great. And although the Netzah-Hod are also covered and sealed, nevertheless it has already been explained elsewhere that the revealed Hassadim strike them and their light goes out to the outside.
